ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: weighted_delta_regret_log_prob_diff_strict
ir.intuition: The original loss failed the JointPreference gate due to symmetry causing loss equality on swap (loss == loss_swap), violating strict preference directionality. To fix this, I introduced a margin term added to the log_prob difference before weighting by delta_regret and weight. The positive margin enforces a strict directional preference, making loss and loss_swap differ, resolving the joint preference violation. This preserves delta_regret weighting for sensitivity, while ensuring consistent ordering of loss values. The margin helps break ties and asymmetrize loss to pass the joint preference gate.
ir.pseudocode:
margin_val = 1e-3
log_prob_diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l + margin_val
loss_per_pair = -weight * delta_regret * log_prob_diff
loss = mean(loss_per_pair)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    delta_regret = batch['delta_regret']
    weight = batch.get('weight', lpw.new_ones(lpw.shape))
    margin_val = 1e-3
    margin_tensor = lpw.new_full(lpw.shape, margin_val)
    log_prob_diff = ops.add(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), margin_tensor)
    loss_per_pair = ops.neg(ops.mul(ops.mul(weight, delta_regret), log_prob_diff))
    return loss_per_pair.mean()
